paragraphs: [Ketubot 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.91a.20-21) relates: the property of the household of Bar Tzartzur was small and then increased. They came before Rav Amram, who sent them before Rav Nachman, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked paragraphs give the increase in the household’s property, the heirs coming before Rav Amram, and his referral to Rav Nachman.
